loopIdea: The reel closes on the same suspended dipstick over the same white cloth it opens on, a fresh bead gathering at the tip, so the replay's catch of the light continues off the drop the last frame held.
mechanicTruth: Automatic transmission fluid starts out bright red and clear, and heat oxidizes it over time, so a brown or black drop with a burnt smell on the dipstick shows the fluid has broken down - it says something changed, not what caused it.
